{{Quote|Avoid them at all costs, my friends. The leader of the so-called Penumbra Omen only briefly identified itself as the "OT-Violator". Their starships seem to be like that of a Hutt smuggler's starcraft, although I certainly doubt any Hutt would be flying any of those ships, at least not like that. '''OT-Violator''' was a mysterious [[Droid/Legends|droid]] active in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a group of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] led by OT-Violator ambushed an unit of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Silverline]] in the [[Area D-512]] of the Naboo system. The Imperial forces suffered heavy casualties and were not able to identify this hostile force that was code-named [[Penumbra Omen]]. Captain Silverline, [[Imperial Authoritarian]], was only able to report that the leader of the assailants identified itself as the OT-Violator. The Empire later prohibited all travel in the Area D-512, renamed Penumbra Omen Quadrant.<ref name="SWG:AER" />

==Behind the scenes==
OT-Violator was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AER" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The document mentioning OT-Violator was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:AER" /> OT-Violator itself was intended to appear as a [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]] in Naboo space but was cut from the game.<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|directory tree files and source data}}</ref>
